name: EFT SCOPE AND RED DOT SIGHT OVERHAUL BY GEFF HANNIGAN - Reupload
teaser: Geff's scope overhaul, just updated to work properly for latest SPT versions
license_name: University of Illinois/NCSA Open Source License
description_html:
Note: due to the optics rework by BSG as of SPT 3.10.0, the compatibility and future of this mod is uncertain. The original author is inactive, and it will take a lot of work to update the bundles, and to check which scopes can be salvaged. The mod is open source, do your best to contact the author, and if you have no response you are free to take on maintaining/updating this mod.

All credit to the original author (please come back ), this is just a re-upload because some people were having trouble getting it running for SPT 3.5.x. I haven’t modified any of the bundles or added new ones.

Check the original mod page for details: EFT Scope and Red Dot Sight Overhaul by Geff Hannigan
